items.title: Ensenada Rachel death toll rises to 7
items.summary: Ensenada, Baja California's death toll from Tropical Cyclone Rachel's remnant flooding rose to 7 on Tuesday, Oct 13 after search crews recovered three more bodies in the Maneadero area: Gael Burgos (14), Valentín Lozano (51), and Keila Sandria (32). Five of the seven were members of one family from Hermosillo, Sonora — Érika Ivonne Burgos (35), Silvia Lucero Burgos (30), Gael Burgos (14), Ivonne Regina Terán Burgos (13), and Aarón Vega Burgos (4) — swept away on Oct 10 when an arroyo overflowed. Three people remain officially missing (Luis Fernando López, 17; Rosalinda Olivera, 24; Rosa María Olivera, 44); a 10-year-old boy, Leonel, was found alive near Rancho Cárdenas. Sonora governor Alfonso Durazo said Tuesday his administration is coordinating with Baja California authorities to transport the bodies home. Combined with the Guerrero Simon victim, the Mexico-wide storm death toll now stands at 8.
